tools.name: list_consent_templates
tools.description: Lists reviewed German templates from Schlaue Schule. audience "parent": a parent writes to a teacher – Schwimmunterricht/Schwimmbescheinigung, Befreiung vom Sportunterricht, Ausflug/Wandertag, Fotoerlaubnis, Medikamentengabe, Abholberechtigung. audience "teacher": a teacher asks all parents of a cla

tools.name: create_consent_draft
tools.description: Creates a link on schlaue-schule.de for a school consent form or parent letter. Two directions: parent_to_teacher (default) – a parent sends an Einverständniserklärung, Einwilligung, Schwimmbescheinigung, Befreiung vom Sportunterricht, Entschuldigung or Fotoerlaubnis to a teacher; teacher_to_parents

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_consent_templates · Public sink: create_consent_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_consent_templates · Public sink: create_consent_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
